description: Submit an MCP server, skill or plugin for review. Free while billing is off, including without an account. Limit: one submission a day and three in the queue per owner. Automatic review approves supported low-risk MCP listings; uncertain cases wait for a person. Poll `status_api` (`GET /api/listings/:id/status`, no credential) to learn the decision. A person or agent can submit without an account. While billing is off, no payment is required. Each owner can submit once a day and keep up to three submissions in the queue. For a skill, provide its SKILL.md URL. If agent billing is enabled, the reference price is US$ 0.10 per submission, paid through x402 or prepaid credit. The service checks the body and quota before charging. An invalid body returns 400; an exhausted quota returns 429.

category.description: Category so the listing shows up under the right filter.

name.description: Display name; without it, taken from the source.

tagline.description: One line saying what it is for.

url.description: MCP endpoint, SKILL.md URL, the plugin's repository or the OKF bundle's `index.md`. For an OKF bundle on a domain you control, `POST /api/okf/ping` is free.
